An Automobile Race Meet for cars and drivers in good standing with the Contest Board of the USAC
will be held as described hereinafter under
Track: WISCONSIN STATE FAIR PARK-1 MILE PAVED
Mail Original Entry to Promoter: Wisconsin Auto Racing, Inc., 1200 First St., Milwaukee, Wis.
Mail Duplicate Entry to Representative: George Holck, 2724 S. Fulton St., Milwaukee 7, Wis.
Open only to race cars with maximum displacement and wheelbase limits complying with those specified
for the Midget or Small Car Class, and conforming to National Championship (Small Car) specifications
and special supplementary rules and regulations. Cars of unknown origin may be required to undergo
complete technical examination.

PRACTICE PERIOD-11:00 A. M. to 12:30 P. M. (Central Standard Time). NO EXCEPTIONS.
QUALIFYING TRIALS—Start promptly at 12:45 and stop at 2:30 P. M.
CARS READY TO QUALIFY —but not yet qualified at 2:30 P. M. will be eligible to draw a number
for the remaining positions, providing the starting field is not filled. The lowest drawn numbers have
the preference. USAC Stewards and Management reserve the right to extend qualifying time limit.
Number of cars to start in the race will not be less than 24. Maximum may be increased by the Track
Steward and the Management on the day of the race, at their discretion.
QUALIFIED CARS ELIGIBLE TO START in the race must be ready to take their position in the
lineup at 2:30 P. M. THE RACE WILL START PROMPTLY AT 3:00 P. M. (Central Standard Time).
(Maximum starting field will be limited to 33 cars.)
